firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently saw a zombie movie starts.
officialTieBreak: If there is a tie, the tied players roll a die; the highest roll goes first.
clarifications: After a turn, play proceeds clockwise. The booklet also includes cooperative and scenario modes.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2 gives the zombie-movie criterion and explicit die-roll tie break. Page 12 gives clockwise turns, and page 10 credits Twilight Creations ©2014.
